description: We are a creative team participating in the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge. Our goal is to bring the stories of NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars back to life through compelling storytelling and engaging visuals. We are looking for passionate members who love space history, writing, or graphic design to join us on this cosmic journey!
details: Our project, The Silent Pioneers: Abandoned but not Forgotten, addresses the challenge by transforming historical space hardware data into an engaging digital narrative. It tells the untold stories of NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars, such as the Apollo Lunar Modules, retroreflectors, and the Spirit and Opportunity rovers.
